en: Black‑and‑white / tinted postcard view of a river scene with a steam paddle boat named "Pillnitz" docking at a pier on a calm river. On the right is a small pier building on the water, with a few small boats nearby. In the background are terraced hillsides, cliffs, and a village with several houses and trees. At the top in red Gothic-style script is German text identifying the location on the River Elbe at Diesbar and its steamboat landing.
